items.prompt: Can an input with zero total volume enter this public VWAP task?

options.text: Yes, return 0.0000 as the default price.
options.why: The task does not invent a price for an empty-volume benchmark.

options.text: No, at least one strictly positive-quantity fill is required.
options.why: Positive quantities and nonempty input keep the denominator positive.

options.text: Yes, provided all trade prices are equal.
options.why: Equal prices cannot make a zero denominator defined.

options.text: Yes, replace volume with 1 after accumulation.
